inventory.metadata_scope: Exact type, permission bits, uid, gid, regular-file size, symlink target, mtime at tarfile float precision. Inode, device, ctime, link count and directory disk size are inventory-only because tar does not preserve them.

kernel_logs.fault_pattern: BUG:|\bWARNING:|kernel panic|double fault|soft lockup|hard LOCKUP|unable to handle|general protection fault|Oops:|\[ERROR\]|\[KD_JIT\]\[ERROR\]|invariant_failures=[1-9]|KASAN:|UBSAN:|KCSAN:|KFENCE:|kernel BUG at|refcount_t:|rcu[^\n]*stall|hung task|blocked for more than

limitations: Inventory equality proves preservation relative to the recorded inventory, not capture of files absent from that original inventory.
Archive digests and retained source/binary hashes establish byte identity, not an independent rebuild of those binaries.
A present empty kernel.log means no messages were retained for that session; the audit cannot independently prove runtime log-collector completeness.
No archived scripts, generated code, or benchmark programs were executed. Prepared-source transformations were checked by static in-memory byte comparison.
JIT execution checks use recorded returned-body counters and retirement evidence. NORMAL/publication alone is not treated as execution.
Provider ELF hashes differ between cacheline and rcuht runs and are verified separately; results are not pooled across binary identity.
scope: Independent read-only offline archive, inventory, source, binary and session-log audit. No archived code or VM commands executed.
